mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, POINT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT FROM SHOP_ITEMS WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(ITEM_TYPE) = 'ICON' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, ITEM_ID ASC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, POINT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT FROM SHOP_ITEMS WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND UPPER(ITEM_TYPE) = UPPER(#{itemType}) ORDER BY ITEM_ID ASC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_TYPE, ITEM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, POINT, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT FROM SHOP_ITEMS WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}

SELECT ui.INVENTORY_ID, ui.USER_ID, ui.ITEM_ID, ui.IS_EQUIPPED, ui.PURCHASED_AT, si.ITEM_TYPE, si.ITEM_NAME, si.DESCRIPTION, si.POINT, si.IMAGE_URL FROM USER_INVENTORY ui JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON ui.ITEM_ID = si.ITEM_ID WHERE ui.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY ui.PURCHASED_AT DESC, ui.INVENTORY_ID DESC

SELECT ui.INVENTORY_ID, ui.USER_ID, ui.ITEM_ID, ui.IS_EQUIPPED, ui.PURCHASED_AT, si.ITEM_TYPE, si.ITEM_NAME, si.DESCRIPTION, si.POINT, si.IMAGE_URL FROM USER_INVENTORY ui JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON ui.ITEM_ID = si.ITEM_ID WHERE ui.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ui.ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_USER_INVENTORY.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO USER_INVENTORY ( INVENTORY_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_ID, IS_EQUIPPED, PURCHASED_AT ) VALUES ( #{inventoryId}, #{userId}, #{itemId}, NVL(#{isEquipped, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_INVENTORY ui SET IS_EQUIPPED = 'N' WHERE ui.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ui.ITEM_ID IN ( SELECT si.ITEM_ID FROM SHOP_ITEMS si WHERE UPPER(si.ITEM_TYPE) = UPPER(#{itemType}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ITEM_ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_ID, POINT, ORDER_STATUS, ORDERED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{point}, NVL(#{orderStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'COMPLETED'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT io.ORDER_ID, io.USER_ID, io.ITEM_ID, io.POINT, io.ORDER_STATUS, io.ORDERED_AT, si.ITEM_NAME, si.ITEM_TYPE, si.IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_ORDERS io JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON io.ITEM_ID = si.ITEM_ID WHERE io.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT io.ORDER_ID, io.USER_ID, io.ITEM_ID, io.POINT, io.ORDER_STATUS, io.ORDERED_AT, si.ITEM_NAME, si.ITEM_TYPE, si.IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_ORDERS io JOIN SHOP_ITEMS si ON io.ITEM_ID = si.ITEM_ID WHERE io.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY io.ORDERED_AT DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_POINT_TRANSACTIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO POINT_TRANSACTIONS ( TX_ID, USER_ID, TX_TYPE, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, ORDER_ID, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{txId}, #{userId}, #{txType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{orderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TX_ID, USER_ID, TX_TYPE, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, ORDER_ID, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT FROM POINT_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, TX_ID DESC
SELECT POINT FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET POINT = POINT + #{amount}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, PREDICTION_ID, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, NULL, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
